verdict.rationale: Gram ships a first-party Platform MCP server. Agents in Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or other MCP clients can connect to it to add servers, manage plugins, skills, policies and roles, and read observability data without opening the dashboard. A probe confirms the official MCP server documentation page, and the CLI installs toolsets as MCP servers in agents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent to the platform MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: An org admin working in Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or another MCP client can find and add MCP servers, finish their setup, put them on a plugin, choose who receives a plugin, author skills, manage access roles, review shadow MCP servers, manage risk policies, configure telemetry delivery, and read observability data without opening the dashboard.
install toolsets as MCP servers in AI agents
